page.overview:
Who is Cobal?

Cobal is a green-haired Mogma who frequently accompanies Ledd. He can first be found shortly after Link arrives at Eldin Volcano with Ledd. He expresses surprise to Ledd that Link is not a Bokoblin.

He can then be found talking to Ledd outside of the Earth Temple about getting the inside to obtain the Treasure hidden within. After discussing where the Key to the Temple is hidden, Cobal points out that they could just simply dig their way into the Temple.

Link will shortly encounter Cobal again in the Earth Temple regretting his journey after Ledd has gone missing. He warns Link that he should go home if he wants to live.

The last place Link can encounter Cobal is within the deep beneath Eldin Volcano. He can be found in the room full of Pyrups near a bombable wall. When talked to, Cobal will encourage Link to search for Rupees in the . After he finishes talking, Fi will unlock Rupee Dowsing for Link.
